about_the_game:
Step into the boots of a cowboy and challenge your mind with this unique, Wild West-themed chess puzzle game! Sharpen your strategy skills as you solve challenging puzzles inspired by the rugged frontier. From outlaws to sheriffs, each piece is brought to life with stunning western-style graphics, offering an engaging twist on the classic game of chess.


Chess meets Paper Please.

Features:

  • Wild West Setting: Immerse yourself in a cowboy-themed world with beautifully designed puzzle boards and pieces.

  • Challenging Puzzles: Test your chess skills with progressively harder puzzles that challenge even seasoned players.

  • Easy to Play: Simple controls make it perfect for both beginners and experienced players.

  • Unlockable Content: Progress through levels and unlock new puzzles and exciting game modes.And improve your chess skills while playing. We also have offline chess features where you can play chess against customized bots.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS (64-bit) or SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU @ 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000 or equivalent (OpenGL 3.3 support)
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: No internet required
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (64-bit) or newer / SteamOS 3.0
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (6th gen) / AMD Ryzen 3 or better
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 / NVIDIA GT 1030 / AMD RX 550 or better
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
